name: 모션 추정 잔차 분석
description: Analyzes motion estimation residual energy — AI-generated motion creates distinctive residual patterns.
mechanism:
This method analyzes motion estimation residuals for video deepfake detection:

1. **동작추정**: Dense optical flow is computed between consecutive frames using established algorithms (Farnebäck, Lucas-Kanade, or variational methods). This estimates per-pixel motion vectors describing the apparent motion field.

2. **Residual계산**: The motion-compensated prediction is computed by warping frame t using the estimated flow to predict frame t+1. The residual R = I_{t+1} − W(I_t, flow) captures what the motion model couldn't predict — new content, disoccluded regions, and artifacts.

3. **Residual분포분석**: Natural video produces motion estimation residuals with characteristic distributions: small residuals in smooth regions (well-predicted), larger at occlusion boundaries and newly visible regions. The method analyzes residual statistics — AI-generated video may show anomalous residual patterns, particularly in face regions where generation artifacts create unpredictable inter-frame changes.

4. **얼굴-BackgroundResidual비교**: The residual characteristics of face regions vs. background are compared. In authentic video, both regions show similar residual statistics (same camera motion, natural object motion). Deepfakes may produce elevated face residuals because the independently generated face doesn't follow physically consistent inter-frame motion.

5. **시간적Residual패턴분석**: The temporal signal of residual magnitude is tracked. Periodic or anomalous patterns — such as regular residual spikes at the generator's refresh rate or systematically higher face residuals — indicate deepfake manipulation. The score quantifies the deviation from expected motion estimation residual behavior.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
